title: pmkit config
description: The pmkit config of a repository, in .pmkit/config.yaml. It names the tracker, the git host and the write policy. Keys pmkit does not know are allowed.

version.title: Config version
version.description: The version of this file's format. Always 1.

system.title: Tracker system
system.description: The tracker pmkit reads and writes. local works today. A hosted system works once pmkit has its adapter.

path.title: Tracker path
path.description: Local only. The folder of the local tracker, relative to the repository root. When it is missing or empty (null), pmkit uses .issues.

scope.title: Tracker scope
scope.description: Hosted trackers only: the names that pick the team, project or space, such as team: ENG. Ignored by the local tracker.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The workspace of a hosted tracker, as the URL key in its web address, such as acme.

additionalProperties.title: Scope name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the team, project or space this key picks, such as ENG.

system.title: Git host system
system.description: github opens pull requests with the gh CLI; none turns pull requests off.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The repository on the git host, as owner/repo.

default_branch.title: Default branch
default_branch.description: The branch pull requests target, such as main.

write_policy.title: Write policy
write_policy.description: When pmkit asks before it writes to the tracker.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: When a command asks before a write: all_writes, single_writes or none. none never skips a preview.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The changes that always show a full preview first.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: Hosted trackers only: how pmkit's statuses and field roles map to the tracker's own names.

status.title: Status mappings
status.description: A category, or blocked, to the tracker's status name, such as in_review: In Review.

additionalProperties.title: Status name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the tracker's status for this category.

fields.title: Field mappings
fields.description: A field role to the tracker's field name, or native for the tracker's own field.

additionalProperties.title: Field name
additionalProperties.description: The name of the tracker's field for this role, or native for the tracker's own field.
